A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PlotCraft benchmark, SynthVis-30K dataset and PlotCraftor model. All 60 pages, including Appendices A–I, are readable and support reliable comparison of text, equations, tables and figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original model evaluations on PlotCraft, VisEval and PandasPlotBench, together with human–judge agreement measurements and qualitative error analyses (Tables 2–4 and 7–9; Appendices G–I).

after.justification: v2 retains these original model evaluations, agreement measurements and qualitative analyses, including the results in the appendices.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 and Appendix E retain the same multi-agent synthesis pipeline, training-trajectory construction and supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B. No method component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use SynthVis-30K for training and evaluate on PlotCraft, VisEval and PandasPlotBench. PlotCraft's 982 instances, single-turn and multi-turn tasks, domains, chart types and difficulty coverage remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 2, 3 and 7 and the qualitative comparisons in Appendix G. Appendix H also retains the same alternative automated judges.

E3.justification: Training settings, decoding, token limits, scoring rubrics, benchmark restrictions and execution environment remain unchanged. The human evaluation still uses 500 charts, three annotators and majority voting.

E4.justification: The difficulty and scaling analyses, judge-validation analyses, qualitative comparisons and error cases are retained unchanged in Sections 5.2–5.4 and Appendices C and G–I. Moving Figure 5 does not introduce a new analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report averages over three experimental runs and the same Cohen's Kappa agreement analysis. Repeated-run information and statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted evidence and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Tables 2 and 7 retain average scores of 6.16 for PlotCraftor, 4.95 for its base model and 6.20 for Claude-4-Sonnet.

T1.justification: The task formalization C = F(I, M, D) in Section 3.1 and the existing task and scoring definitions are unchanged. No mathematical reasoning, theorem or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same benchmark, dataset and model contributions and the same performance claims. Removing the abstract's future-release sentence changes resource documentation rather than the scientific contribution.

C2.justification: Interpretations of scaling and task difficulty remain unchanged, as do the qualifications concerning GPT-oss's input format, costly data synthesis and imperfect visual judges. The conclusion and appendix discussions are retained despite text reflow.

D1.justification: v1 provides a project-repository link and a future-release statement. v2 retains that project destination and adds a dataset-labeled link, 'Qwen3-Coder/PlotCraft', on the title page. This adds access information; implementation details are unchanged, and the PDFs do not establish the linked resources' completeness.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, bibliography and positioning against earlier visualization benchmarks remain unchanged. No cited work or substantive novelty relationship is added or removed.

P1.justification: Limited front-matter edits update the Alibaba affiliation, shorten the contact line, add internship attribution and relocate resource information. Scientific prose, section order and appendix organization remain unchanged apart from reflow.

P2.justification: v2 changes title-page branding and resource-link layout, thickens the running-header rule and shifts Figure 1. Figure 5 moves earlier within page 8, reflowing text across pages 8–10. Scientific figure and table content remains unchanged.

improvement.justification: The specific dataset pointer and prominent resource labels provide a small improvement in resource discoverability over v1's general release statement. Methods, results and appendix evidence are unchanged, so the benefit is limited to access documentation; actual resource availability cannot be established from the PDFs.
